description: This file defines an API client module for accessing project-related summaries from a backend service. It includes a function to fetch project summaries with optional date range parameters, utilizing imported utility functions for API client creation and organization ID retrieval.

methods.name: getProjectsSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches project creation summaries filtered by optional time range parameters. It constructs a query, incorporates organizational context, and performs an HTTP GET request to the backend API endpoint `/projects/summary`.
